title: fix(lint, metadata-protocol)!: the object_extension publish door folds the written entry among other packages' extensions by priority, as os build does
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X5DTB6H6vWGj3p1JFrKB58W)_

Fixes #33494

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — at the runtime `object_extension` publish door (Studio, `PUT /api/v1/meta/object_extension/TARGET`, the MCP and AI authoring doors) the expression rule now reads each field of the target as `os build` serves it when another package's published extension adds the same field. One shape it accepted is now refused (shape 3: a higher-priority package's formula for a field the written entry also adds closes a cycle through another field of the entry), and two it refused now publish (shape 1, a tie at the priority that decides the field; shape 2, the written entry outranked there). `os build`, `os validate` and `os lint` are unchanged. The new gate input (`storedObjectExtensions` on `runRuntimeAuthoringRules` and `evaluateRuntimeAuthoringGate`, the `StoredObjectExtension` type from `@objectstack/lint/runtime`) is optional and additive. Measured first-party exposure: no two first-party packages extend the same object (`examples/app-showcase` one entry on `showcase_account`; `packages/plugins/plugin-auth` one on `sys_sso_provider`; HotCRM `origin/main` 2492ac6 one module, o2c, extending `crm_contract` and `crm_account`), so no first-party write changes verdict.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none owed — this PR edits `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx` (the object extension paragraph states the door's fold); the skills teach `defineObjectExtension({ extend, fields, priority })` and formula fields and say nothing of how the door read a field two packages add.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：运行时 `object_extension` 发布口在判断扩展字段（如公式循环）时，现在把其他软件包已发布的同目标扩展连同其优先级一起折叠，用的是 `os build` 的同一个折叠函数，所以发布口看到的字段定义与 build 一致：同优先级冲突的字段两边都不判，被更高优先级覆盖的字段按覆盖者的定义判。
- **为什么改**：此前发布口拿到的目标对象里，其他包加的字段是没有优先级的普通字段，写入条目总是盖在上面。结果有两种情况发布口拒绝而 build 放行（同优先级、被更高优先级覆盖），一种情况发布口放行而 build 拒绝（更高优先级的兄弟公式经由本条目的另一个字段构成循环）。
- **风险与回滚**：发布口一处收窄、两处放宽，build 不变。需要两个软件包扩展同一对象的同名字段并带公式循环才会触发；第一方实测没有两个包扩展同一对象。新输入是可选的，宿主不提供时行为与之前相同。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**：`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`（扩展遍历：stored 条目只折叠不判定、回填跳过 stored 名称）、`packages/lint/src/object-graph.ts`（`objectExtensionsByTarget` / `objectsAsServed` 的 `stored` 参数）、`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-authoring-gate.ts`（`otherPackagesExtensionsOf`）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/runtime-gate.object-formula-cycle.test.ts`，预期 20 条全过，其中 `#33494` 一组 5 条：同优先级与被覆盖两种情形发布口与 build 都放行，更高优先级兄弟公式构成的循环在发布口按本条目的字段拒绝。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**`packages/lint/src/object-graph.ts`.** `objectExtensionsByTarget(stack, stored = [])` and `objectsAsServed(stack, stored = [])` take an optional list of `StoredObjectExtension` (an extension the host's registry already holds for another package: `extend`, `priority`, `fields`, `packageId`). Each is collected by the fold's own `collect`, one carrier per entry below 0 (registered before the stack's own entries), marked `stored: true` on its `VisibleObjectExtension`. They sort and fold exactly as any entry: ascending priority, a later writer replacing the whole field, a name whose deciding writers share a priority put in `tied`. The build never passes the list, so every build verdict is what it was.

**`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`.** `StackExpressionOptions.storedObjectExtensions`, read on an `object_extension` write only (`storedExtensions`). It reaches the top-of-pass fold (`objectsAsServed(stack, storedExtensions)`, so the field, type and nullable indexes see the build's winner and leave a tie out) and the extension walk (`objectExtensionsByTarget(stack, storedExtensions)`). In the walk a stored entry is folded in and never judged or located; the fill-back from `base` (the target as served before the write, which carries the stored entries' fields as plain fields) skips the names they add, so a tied name is not served again as one sibling's definition. The call-site comment is rewritten to this reading. Neither edit touches the gate-setup region PR #33434 edits (its hunks at ~:2374-2380 and after ~:2396; this PR changes the one fold call between them, as the seat's surface amendment allows).

**`packages/lint/src/formula-cycle-issues.ts`.** `extensionFormulaLoci` reads `stored`: a stored entry locates nothing, and a name it adds later in fold order than the written entry removes the written entry's locus (the sibling's definition is the one served). So a cycle a higher sibling closes through another field of the written entry is named on that field alone, and the sibling's member is never charged to the write.

**`packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.ts`, `authoring-rules.ts`, `runtime.ts`.** `runRuntimeAuthoringRules({ storedObjectExtensions })` (optional) hands the list to `AuthoringRuleContext.storedObjectExtensions` on an `object_extension` write only, the same value in every pass; the expression rule passes it to `runStackExpressionPasses`. `@objectstack/lint/runtime` exports the `StoredObjectExtension` type.

**`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-authoring-gate.ts`, `runtime-authoring-gate.ts`.** New `otherPackagesExtensionsOf(registry, target, writtenPackage)`: each `extend` contributor of the target (`getObjectContributors`) of a package other than the written one, with its priority and fields, in the registry's order; a disabled package's left out (`isPackageDisabled`, as every served fold withholds it); `[]` for a registry that cannot answer. `judgeRuntimeAuthoringRules` states it on an `object_extension` write (the target and package `objectExtensionWriteFold` already names) and `evaluateRuntimeAuthoringGate` passes it through (optional `storedObjectExtensions`). No `packages/spec` schema moves: the registry already held each sibling's package and priority.

**`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-extension-formula-cycle-refused.ts`** (PR #33442's entry, not yet released): `reason` and `acceptanceCriteria` now state the door's fold, "at the priority that decides it" in place of "at the same priority", and the tie exception for both the build and the door on a declared object.

**`content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`**: the object extension paragraph's last sentence states the door's fold and "at the priority that decides it".

**`.changeset/33494-extension-door-priority-fold.md`**: `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/spec` minor, both declaration lines, the `Skills-docs:` line, a BREAKING banner (Before / Now / Unchanged / Fix) and `adr-0087: not-required (already-registered object-extension-formula-cycle-refused)` (this PR updates that unreleased entry rather than registering a new one). Its **Now** paragraph corrects, by quotation, the pending `.changeset/33153-extension-formula-cycle.md` Now clause and Unchanged sentence the carry note 6886038545 names, and "at the same priority" there. That changeset is not edited (it is another PR's).

## Why

Card #33494 (from PR #33442's contract review, record 6885259034 finding 1 and its observation): the door's snapshot (#33072) carried every other package's extension field on the target as a plain field with no priority, so the gate folded the written entry over all of them. `os build` folds every package's entry by priority and serves the winner. The door refused a tie and an outranked entry the build accepts, and accepted a higher sibling's cycle through another field of the entry that the build refuses.

## Tests

1. **`packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.object-formula-cycle.test.ts`**: the #33153 pin "the door judges the written entry's own definition whatever a sibling's priority" is replaced by a `#33494` describe (5 cases) at the real gate (`runRuntimeAuthoringRules`, `type: 'object_extension'`, with `storedObjectExtensions`) and the build (`runAuthoringRules('build', …)` over both packages):
   - ⭐ shapes 1 and 2: a tie (200/200) and an outranked entry (sibling 300, written 200), the written `s__c` reading itself: no cycle finding at the door, none in the build.
   - ⭐ LIT shape 3: the sibling (300) serves `s__c = record.a__c + 1`, the written entry (200) adds `s__c` (number) and `a__c = record.s__c * 2`: refused at the door on `a__c` only, in the engine's sentence (`formulaCycleMessage('a__c', ['a__c', 's__c'])`); the build names the sibling's `s__c` at the sibling's entry and `a__c` at the written entry.
   - the entry that outranks the sibling (300 over 200) is still refused at the door at the entry, and by the build at the same entry.
   - a tied name the sibling stored as a self-reading formula is not served back from the target and not charged to the write (door and build both clean).
   - a host that states no extensions leaves the door as it was (the written entry folded over the served target).
2. **`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-object-extension-item.test.ts`**, new describe `[#33494]` (4 cases) through the real `saveMetaItem` + `publishMetaItem`, with a third package registered as an extender of the account (`registerObjectExtension`, priority 200 or 300): ⭐ the tie and the outranked self-reading formula publish (the row goes active), as `os build` accepts each; ⭐ shape 3 gets 422 `INVALID_METADATA` with `expression-invalid` at `object 'crm_account' · objectExtensions[0] · field 'a__c' expression` and the row stays a draft; CONTROL: an entry outranking the sibling with a self-reading formula is still refused.
3. **`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-authoring-gate.extension-write-fold.test.ts`**, new describe `[#33494]` (2 cases): `otherPackagesExtensionsOf` lists every other package's `extend` contributor in the registry's order with its priority and fields, leaving out the owner, the written package and a disabled package; a registry with no contributors member, or one that throws, states none.
4. **Meta-tests** (`validate-expressions.test.ts`, `validate-security-posture.test.ts`, #5017 receiver scans): `storedNames` (a Set of names) and `stored` (the fold's list parameter) tabled as plumbing receivers, each with its reason.

**Red at base:** the head's lint test file over the base lint sources (`git restore --source=41b64bb0` of the six lint source files): 2 of 20 red, the shapes 1/2 case and the shape 3 LIT; restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

**Ablations** (one-shot through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on committed head `e681d49f`; each restore verdict "blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty"; lint tests read `src/`):

- A1, the fill-back skip (`&& !storedNames.has(n)` dropped): 1 of 20 red, the tied-name case.
- A2, stored entries locating (`if (entry.stored) loci.delete(name)` made unreachable behind a `globalThis` marker): 1 of 20 red, the shape 3 LIT (the sibling's `s__c` charged to the write). A first attempt was a no-op (its replacement kept the anchor text; the tool refused and restored), so it was rerun with the marker.
- A3, the top fold without the stored list (`objectsAsServed(stack)`): 2 of 20 red, shapes 1/2 and shape 3.
- R1, the host carry, for the runtime pins that read metadata-protocol through `dist/`: the registry handed as `globalThis.__ablationR1` (undefined) in `judgeRuntimeAuthoringRules`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol run build`, `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in `dist/`, runtime `-t 33494`: 3 red (both publish LITs and the shape 3 LIT), the CONTROL green. Restore leg: rebuilt, `--absent` found no marker, 4/4 green. (A first R1 attempt was also a no-op for the same reason and is not counted.)

## Acceptance notes

- **Where the snapshot is built** (measured): `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-authoring-gate.ts` (`judgeRuntimeAuthoringRules`), not `packages/runtime/src/domains/`; the seat amended the claim's surface (6888588670).
- **No second fold.** The door's fold is `objectsAsServed` / `objectExtensionsByTarget` with the host's entries added to their input; the tie set and the ordering are the build's.
- **A tied name the target's owner also declares**: in the build the tied name is filled back from the authored object (the object walk's); at the door the target's base layer is not carried (only the served target), so the walk leaves every name a stored entry adds to the fold, and such a name is absent there. It needs an owner field re-declared by two packages at the priority that decides it, plus a formula cycle through it; the verdict charged to the write can only differ by a member under that name. Noted, not filed.
- **A disabled package's extension** is left out (`isPackageDisabled`), as the served fold leaves it out; an enable door's `asEnabled` reading is not this write's.
- **The legacy `NS__NAME` filing** (`extensionTargetKey`, #28858) is not mirrored: the host reads the contributors under the target the body names, as the gate folds it.
- **Other as-served checks on this door** read the same fold now (the field-formula and validation-rule passes' field, type and nullable indexes), so a type or null-guard verdict on a field another package outranks is the build's too.
- **Not changed, by the order's fence:** `packages/spec` schemas; the door roster and its pins; PR #33434's hunks.
